image_description: A low-angle shot of a stylized, curved street sign assembly against a deep blue sky. The structure consists of a dark arched top bar with white lettering and red decorative elements, a central dark rectangular panel, and a lower elongated oval/rectangular sign with large, distressed white typography on a weathered background. The signs are mounted on a vertical post visible on the right side.
